offering_description.value: Designs, makes and markets household disposables such as aluminum foil, plastic wrap, trash and food storage bags, and cookware sold through retailers to consumers. Products are manufactured in company plants and sold mainly to grocery, mass and club retailers.

primary_products.value: aluminum foil; plastic wrap; trash bags; food storage bags; parchment and baking paper; disposable tableware

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchants, club stores, drug stores and e-commerce retailers

end_markets.value: household consumer goods; grocery and food retail; foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded household disposables sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes foil, wrap and bags in its own plants, sold to retailers and distributors; brand owner: owns and markets the Reynolds and Hefty brands sold through retail channels

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with sales in Canada and some Latin American markets

specialization.value: related lines: aluminum foil, plastic wrap, trash and storage bags, parchment and disposable tableware sold to the same retail customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national retail accounts; distributors / dealers: wholesale distributors serving smaller grocery and convenience stores; online: sales through retailers' e-commerce websites and online marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food-contact material rules for wraps and foils, product safety and labeling standards for bags and disposables
